content:
The v4.15.0 release of Lean is here!

There are many bugfixes, performance gains, and improvements to the Lean language. Please read the release notes for details.

We encourage everyone using previous stable releases to update their repositories to v4.15.0.

Batteries, Aesop, ProofWidgets, and Mathlib are all now available for v4.15.0.

  • the stable branch on each repository has been updated to use v4.15.0
  • there is a v4.15.0 tag in each repository if you would like to pin to a commit using this toolchain.
(Note that I'm delaying the announcement of v4.16.0-rc1 for now, as we intend to release a v4.16.0-rc2 soon, and encourage most users to wait for that.)
